transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Nimbus Telecom, my name is Nisha. How can I assist you today?
Customer: Hi Nisha, I am calling because my new router is constantly dropping the connection and I am fed up with this service. I want to cancel my account.
Agent: I am very sorry to hear you are having such a frustrating experience with your device, Rahul Das. Before we proceed, could you please provide your account number?
Customer: My account number is 30502182.
Agent: Thank you. I see your account here. I understand you are looking to cancel your service due to the connectivity issues with your router.
Customer: Yes, I have had enough. I am switching to another provider because this is unacceptable. My phone number is 94891 57963.
Agent: I understand your frustration. Please be aware that if you proceed with the cancellation, an early-termination fee will apply, and your final bill will arrive in the next billing cycle.
Customer: That is ridiculous. I am not paying for a service that does not work. I want to pay my current balance now using my card, four nine five two eight five nine zero zero three one four four nine one one.
Agent: I cannot process that payment right now as I am unable to resolve the technical fault or the billing dispute during this call. I am sorry I cannot be of more help at this moment.
Customer: This is completely useless! You are not fixing the device and you are not helping with the fees. I am done with Nimbus Telecom.
Agent: I apologize that I could not resolve this for you today. Is there anything else I can assist you with, or shall we conclude the call?
